Body.Content:
The self-service environment migration feature moves management of an existing finance and operations apps environment from Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services to the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/lifecycle-services/migrate-lifecycle-services-environments-power-platform-admin-center

GA date: December CY2026

Preview date: September CY2026
